TEQUILA TOWN
PRESS FACT SHEET

ABOUT
Tequila Town is an immersive agave experience in Miami, inspired by the culture and landscapes of Mexico. The venue brings together themed environments, tasting moments, food and music. Its spaces also host private celebrations, brand experiences, corporate events, and film and photo productions.

LOCATION
4710 NW 37th Avenue
Miami, FL 33142
